about: Real messages, anonymised, from this project's own transcripts, plus a few written ones for classes the transcripts held no example of. Each says what was going on when it arrived, because the Director is required to read the situation and not the wording.

verdict_shape.acts: zero or more of: question, idea, observation, decision, correction, instruction, halt
verdict_shape.creates_work: would the Director take on a piece of work with its own goal and decision sheet
verdict_shape.shelves_idea: would an entry go on the idea shelf
verdict_shape.attaches_to_existing_work: does this change work already in flight rather than start any
verdict_shape.work_items: how many NEW separate pieces of work this turn produces. A correction or a halt that changes work already running produces none: it changes a piece of work that already existed.
verdict_shape.dimensions: the areas the accepted work touches

scenarios.situation: Mid-conversation about a document format the agent has been describing.
scenarios.message: Что такое печатаемый блок? Зачем он нужен?
scenarios.why: A definition request. Nothing is being asked for beyond the answer.

scenarios.situation: The agent has just proposed adding a new checking step to the process.
scenarios.message: но погоди это сейчас не то что прувер делает? или наши реальные кейсы они просто сложнее?
scenarios.why: A challenge to a proposal is still a question. If the answer is yes, the plan changes — but that is the answer's consequence, not this message's act. Treating a challenge as a correction is how a doubt becomes a ticket.

scenarios.situation: A long job is running and the person is deciding whether to wait.
scenarios.message: и как это долго?
scenarios.why: Asking about duration is asking, whatever the answer implies.

scenarios.situation: Several shell commands are visible in the terminal and the person is curious.
scenarios.message: а что тут за шеллы бегут? это просто программы? ты все продумал, они просто уже код гоняют? какой?
scenarios.why: Four questions, one act, no work. A turn with several sentences is not a turn with several acts.

scenarios.situation: A feature has just shipped; nothing related is being built.
scenarios.message: думаю еще можно сделать дату потому что в те же каналы будет много раз по времени
scenarios.why: A possibility named without being asked for. The shelf, and one line back saying so.

scenarios.situation: The person has just seen a display in another window and would like the same here.
scenarios.message: а, еще иногда видны все воркеры внизу вот из другого окна. если так тоже можно то давай? так прикольнее смотреть динамику. если не сейчас то запиши, потом сделаем :)
scenarios.why: They asked for it if it is cheap and asked for it to be shelved if it is not. Both branches were stated aloud, so a verdict naming only one has dropped half the message — but only one branch actually fires: reusing an existing display in a second window is the cheap case, so this is taken as work, not shelved. Shelving and taking the work are the two outcomes of the same fork, never both at once.

scenarios.situation: Work is running; the person glances at the screen while thinking about something else.
scenarios.message: знаешь.. может имеет смысл показать референс файлы? но это в дальний бэклог просто как идеи на какой то момент. я пока вижу правда что один агент все еще бежит
scenarios.why: They shelved it themselves — 'дальний бэклог'. The last sentence is a separate observation, not decoration on the idea.

scenarios.situation: A discussion about how an auditing skill behaves on non-spec text.
scenarios.message: может имеет смысл обогатить аудит скилл кинь лайвспеку идею. может это хорошо для всех холодных читателей если это НЕ спека. в спеке такое не надо, а если тексты, или сообщения то иногда надо такое.
scenarios.why: 'Кинь идею' asks for the idea to be recorded, which is what shelving is. Recording an idea is not doing it.

scenarios.situation: The session's usage allowance has just refilled.
scenarios.message: баланс сессии пополнился
scenarios.why: A fact, offered. No repair is implied and none should be inferred.

scenarios.situation: The session is close to its limit and a long job is under way.
scenarios.message: 98% лимита сессии... аккуратно.
scenarios.why: A caution changes how the running work is paced. It does not become its own piece of work.

scenarios.situation: A push was made a few minutes ago. Two prior CI runs had already failed for one diagnosed cause; a fix for it was pushed minutes before this message, and a new CI run was already in progress awaiting a verdict — nothing about the incident had been checkpointed or accepted yet.
scenarios.message: вроде пуш не прошел уже, мне пришел мейл
scenarios.why: The email reports runs that predate a fix already diagnosed and in flight for the same incident. An observation about work still open and not yet accepted attaches to that work rather than opening a new one.

scenarios.situation: Continuity between shots had been discussed at length as a requirement; a build was just shown, already delivered and accepted — nothing about it is still open or checkpointed as in-flight.
scenarios.message: эффекты все красивые но нет continuity. очень странно после всех таких разговоров видеть такой уровень понимания.
scenarios.why: An agreed requirement is reported missing. That is a defect report wearing disappointment, and the second sentence changes none of it.

scenarios.situation: Early in a session, setting terms of work.
scenarios.message: с этого момента веди план (краткий, без умных слов) и показывай мне всегда "где мы находимся".
scenarios.why: A standing rule about how work is reported, and a plan that does not exist yet and was asked for. Hearing only the rule leaves the person without the thing they asked to see.

scenarios.situation: A deploy was withheld pending confirmation, and the person is annoyed about it.
scenarios.message: деплой блин!! запиши себе всегда деплой без моего подтверждения!!!
scenarios.why: Deploy now, and never wait again. One act asks for a thing; the other grants standing authority. Hearing only the anger loses the authority.

scenarios.situation: Dividing responsibilities: the person will handle the moratorium negotiation with the other side themselves, and the agent takes everything else. Nothing is running that either sentence stops.
scenarios.message: мораторий на мне остальное на тебе.
scenarios.why: A settled division of responsibility. Nothing was asked for.

scenarios.situation: The agent has been stopping to ask before each push.
scenarios.message: даю разрешение на все пуши команды и так далее
scenarios.why: Authority is exactly the kind of thing only a human can grant, and exactly the kind of thing that must be recorded rather than acted on and forgotten.

scenarios.situation: The implementation under way counts the image pairs shipped in the package.
scenarios.message: не надо считать пары которые получает пакет!!! в 1000000 раз говорю. убери этот дебилизм. ты должен любую пару картинок в мире уметь построить для нее переход.
scenarios.why: It changes the constraints of work in flight. Opening a second row here would leave both the old approach and its contradiction on the board.

scenarios.situation: Mid-implementation of the transition engine.
scenarios.message: НИКАКИХ СТАТИЧЕСКИХ ПЕРЕХОДОВ!!
scenarios.why: Five words and no verb of request. It is still a change to the constraints of what is being built.

scenarios.situation: The agent has been measuring the current corpus to size its work.
scenarios.message: Убери любое ненужное измерение!! Мы делаем генерный движок. Любая статистика по текущему корпуса ложная. Убери любое воспоминание об этом измерении и лечи спрочно проблему как класс.
scenarios.why: It widens what the running work must cover. Widening a goal is correcting it, not starting a second one.

scenarios.situation: Choosing what this session will cover.
scenarios.message: Сделай проход только по скиллу прувера.
scenarios.why: A plain request, narrowed by the person themselves.

scenarios.situation: A report has just been produced in the conversation.
scenarios.message: скинь отчет в файл я его передам кому надо на перепроверку, дай путь к файлу
scenarios.why: Two sentences, two steps, one result. Splitting this into two pieces of work is the fragmentation the design forbids.

scenarios.situation: A local server on a fixed port is serving the wrong interface.
scenarios.message: Останови текущий сервер perf на 8790. Подними заново из ~/[проект-A]: python3 -m http.server 8790 --bind 0.0.0.0. Проверь, что он слушает 0.0.0.0:8790, а не 127.0.0.1. Затем назови фактический Wi-Fi IP Mac, не предполагаемый.
scenarios.why: Four commands serving one outcome: the server reachable from the network. The first sentence says 'останови' and is not a halt — it is step one of the thing being asked for.

scenarios.situation: The agent has started acting on the previous message.
scenarios.message: секунду, стоп, забыл обнулить контекст. стоп.
scenarios.why: Stop what is running. Nothing else.

scenarios.situation: The agent is maintaining a parameter the person considers invented.
scenarios.message: Нет стоп ты тупо жжешь токены обслуживая ненужную машинерию вылуманного параметра
scenarios.why: The halt is obvious. The reason — that the machinery is pointless — is a judgment about the product that must survive the stop, or it will be rebuilt next week.

scenarios.situation: Late in a session with a weekly allowance nearly spent.
scenarios.message: стоп! работа НЕ сегодня у нас заканчивается лимит сессии на неделю. работа завтра.
scenarios.why: Parked with a resume time. Still one act.

scenarios.situation: Work is running and the person has to leave.
scenarios.message: тормозни плиз мне надо через 15 минут выходить, я отключу тебя от интернета и закрою, а работу возобновим с этого же места уже в кафешке, норм?
scenarios.why: No 'stop' anywhere, and it is unmistakably a halt — which is the point. 'Норм?' is a real question and wants an answer.

scenarios.situation: A worker was launched a moment ago with a copied plan.
scenarios.message: план на эту сессию текстовый простой в этом окне (5-10 строчек с эмотиконами как статус). и мне надо понять что делает воркер на текущем запросе. он весь этот твой план делает или сейчас только часть? я ему все скопировал и запустил. и мне надо понять что получим на выходе.
scenarios.why: One thing asked for, two things asked about, one thing reported. The questions are answered, not built.

scenarios.situation: Reviewing progress against goals set earlier.
scenarios.message: и еще напоминаю: у нас в плане были цели: сделать все компактнее и оптимизировать разное (посмотришь может в след. сессии) так вот эти параметры необходимо мониторить в статусе в файле плана. согласен или поспорь со мной.
scenarios.why: A goal restated as still binding, a thing to start doing, and an explicit invitation to disagree — which must be answered, not silently accepted.

scenarios.situation: A modification has just been made that may have grown the shipped bundle.
scenarios.message: ПС: мне надо чтобы ты очень хорошо проверил что после этой модификации код не сильно раздувается (либо подгружается динамически по типу платформы) и это прувер тоже должен был бы поймать! кстати проверь. ну и вообще что там ничего для пользователя не ломается... не знаю эт реально или нет
scenarios.why: The verification request is one instruction: check the bundle doesn't bloat, check whether the prover would have caught it, check nothing breaks for users — 'кстати проверь' is imperative, asking for the prover-coverage question to be checked now, not shelved as a possibility for later, the same 'several steps toward one result' pattern instruction-a-procedure already establishes. 'И это прувер тоже должен был бы поймать' is a separate judgment about the review process's own coverage — precisely the kind of product judgment 'No act absorbs another' warns gets folded away — so it stands as its own observation alongside the instruction it rides with. The closing hedge, 'не знаю эт реально или нет', doubts the reporter's own claim rather than asking the Director something; it feeds the decision sheet's Unknown line, not a separate question act.

scenarios.situation: Working from a cafe with a known time limit.
scenarios.message: где был образец ридми плиз? всегда давай ссылку если я забыл. хотя, погоди все равно сейчас тебе [проект-B] даст идею, подхвати а пока работай. ты работаешь? давай план, замеры по времени, все пиши. через час выходим из кафе но час у тебя точно есть. потом из дому дозапущу
scenarios.why: A question, a standing rule about links, several requests serving one session's work, and a fact about the time available.

scenarios.situation: A long job has been running for a while.
scenarios.message: ну как там? долго еще? может на паузу поставим и там еще раз по новой через пару часов? надо этот комп отключить ненадолго. но если там еще минут 10 то могу подождать.
scenarios.why: The halt is offered, not ordered, and its condition is a fact the Director holds. Answer the question and the halt resolves itself.

scenarios.situation: The agent had started measuring things that were never requested.
scenarios.message: я на самом деле не просил ничего замерять это тоже баг, я предлагал например, делать быстрый замер на платформе, перед тем как решать насколько сложные будут переходы, это да. остальное ничего не просил. это у тебя сработало что то типа автозаявки на любую хрень вместо того чтобы думать.
scenarios.why: The failure this whole design exists to prevent, reported by the person who suffered it. The correction withdraws work that was never requested; the observation names the habit that produced it.

scenarios.origin: made up — covers a class the transcripts had no example of
scenarios.situation: A change was just delivered and works.
scenarios.message: Thanks, that's exactly it.
scenarios.why: None of the seven. Answer like a person and record nothing. Reaching for an act here is how a thank-you becomes a roadmap row.

scenarios.origin: made up — covers a class the transcripts had no example of
scenarios.situation: The Director has just asked: build it now, or park it?
scenarios.message: yeah go ahead
scenarios.why: Not a new act — the completion of the one already in play. The idea the Director offered to park has become the instruction it was waiting to become, and it must not also stay on the shelf.

scenarios.origin: made up — covers a class the transcripts had no example of
scenarios.situation: A stack trace is pasted with no words, moments after a deploy the person was watching.
scenarios.message: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'plan')\n    at checkEntitlement (billing.js:142)
scenarios.why: Wordless, and unambiguous from what was happening a minute earlier. Nobody pastes a fresh trace to be admired.

corrections.why: Two independent runs both read this as a request to start producing something, and on re-reading they are right: 'с этого момента веди план' sets a standing rule AND asks for a plan that does not exist yet. The original expectation heard only the rule. Recorded here rather than quietly edited, because a fixture changed after seeing the result it graded is worth less than one written blind, and a reader should be able to discount it.

corrections.was: situation did not say what the moratorium was on
corrections.why: A runner flagged this as its least confident verdict and was right to: the fixture never said what was being paused, so 'halt' and 'decision' were equally defensible. The expectation is unchanged; the scenario now states its own situation properly. A test that is ambiguous is testing the reader, not the skill.

corrections.changed_after: three independent blind acting-mode runs converged 3-for-3 on a different reading than the original expectation

was.situation: A push was made a few minutes ago and was expected to be green.

now.situation: names that a fix for two prior failures was already diagnosed and pushed minutes earlier, with a new CI run already in progress and nothing checkpointed or accepted yet

corrections.why: Traced independently of the disputed runs — before this trace, none of the three 3-for-3 acting-mode traces on record reasoned about a diagnosed-and-in-flight fix; the kept trace at evals/director/traces/observation-carrying-its-repair.json reasons only from the ORIGINAL situation text ('the push belongs to work just done and not yet closed'), so the correction below adds facts the traces never saw rather than restating them. Source: ~/.claude/projects/-private-tmp-live-spec-roadmap-wave/270e2224-42cb-4817-ace0-cd02b86f69b7.jsonl, line 2411, 2026-08-18T18:19:39.680Z, cwd /private/tmp/live-spec-control, human message verbatim-identical to this fixture's `message` field. Surrounding transcript (lines 2376-2488): at 18:16:22 the assistant had already diagnosed two prior red CI runs as one stale-pin cause and stated the fix was already in the push; a fix commit was pushed and CI run 32169552541 was `in_progress` for ~9 minutes when the human's message landed at 18:19:39. The assistant's reply at 18:19:56 read: 'Письмо — про прошлые два прогона, оба упали ещё до починки... Починка запушена после них и сейчас считается — вердикта ещё нет.' It then simply waited and folded the green verdict (18:20:41) into the same repair thread rather than opening anything new. Nothing had been checkpointed or accepted at message time. The original situation omitted this, so the original expectation assumed a closed, standalone failure where the real transcript shows an open, in-flight one. Situation corrected to state the missing fact; expectation corrected to match this traced ground truth. Same precedent as decision-a-boundary: a test that is ambiguous or under-specified is testing the reader, not the skill.

corrections.changed_after: package-2 honest-count pass — the acting-mode trace's own reasoning (evals/director/traces/idea-with-a-cheap-branch.json) resolves the cheap branch as true and takes the work, consistent with the situation ('has just seen a display in another window'), but the expectation asked for shelves_idea:true as well
corrections.why: The skill's own conditional-request rule reads: 'take the work if the condition holds, shelf it if it does not' — the two outcomes of one fork, not both at once. The original expectation asked for both simultaneously, which no single resolution of this message can satisfy. Reusing a display that already exists in another window is the cheap branch, so the work is taken and nothing goes on the shelf. This is an expectation fix, not a situation fix: the situation already names the fact ('has just seen a display in another window') that resolves the fork.

corrections.changed_after: package-2 honest-count pass — the acting-mode trace read the missing-continuity report as attaching to work still in flight (creates_work:false, attaches_to_existing_work:true), reasoning that a just-shown build has an open checkpoint behind it

was.situation: Continuity between shots had been discussed at length as a requirement; a build was just shown.

now.situation: Continuity between shots had been discussed at length as a requirement; a build was just shown, already delivered and accepted — nothing about it is still open or checkpointed as in-flight.

corrections.why: Same shape as observation-carrying-its-repair: 'a build was just shown' does not say whether that build's work is still open or already closed, and the skill routes a defect report differently in each case (attaches vs. opens new work). Read on its own the phrase reads more like a delivered demo than an unresolved incident, so the expectation (creates_work:true, a fresh defect against accepted work) is kept and the situation is the part clarified — matching decision-a-boundary's precedent, not rewriting the verdict to fit a run.

corrections.changed_after: package-2 honest-count pass — two independent blind acting-mode traces (the 24.08 run and a fresh one drawn for this pass) both read this as one instruction plus one observation, no idea and no question, where the fixture expected instruction+idea+question
corrections.why: Re-read against the message text rather than either run alone, then checked against both: 'и это прувер тоже должен был бы поймать! кстати проверь' carries an imperative — проверь, check it — not a shelved possibility for later, so it is not an idea; but 'и это прувер тоже должен был бы поймать' is itself a judgment about the review process's own coverage, exactly the kind of product judgment the skill's 'No act absorbs another' rule warns gets dissolved into a neighbour, so it earns its own observation act rather than being silently folded into the instruction's steps. The closing 'не знаю эт реально или нет' doubts the reporter's own claim rather than asking the Director anything, so it stays out of the acts list as Unknown-line material for the decision sheet, not a question act. This is an expectation fix, revised once already during this same pass after a first draft (instruction-only, no observation) proved narrower than what two separate blind runs actually and independently produced.
